feature_space_semantics.raw_consumption: All three detectors evaluate the identical 1D raw consumption feature [energy_consumption] over identical eligible timestamps.
feature_space_semantics.seasonal_deviation: All three detectors share the identical 24-hour causal lookback eligibility mask, but statistical_zscore is intentionally a univariate reference baseline scoring 1D |slot_zscore|, whereas isolation_forest and lof_novelty evaluate the 3D vector [slot_zscore, lag_1h_scaled_diff, lag_24h_scaled_diff]. Comparisons in seasonal_deviation therefore compare a univariate marginal seasonal baseline against multivariate seasonal-plus-ramp detectors on the same eligible hours, not identical feature dimensionality.

sensitivity_quintin.note: Separate sensitivity population; excluded from all 29-building core summaries.

zero_frequency_shift_summary.limitation_note: BDG2 Panther education buildings exhibit a major structural shift in valid-zero frequency between 2016 (training) and H1 2017 (validation). All detectors, reference scalers, and quantile thresholds remain strictly frozen on 2016 training data without refitting on validation; consequently, validation alert rates reflect both point deviations and this underlying 2016-to-2017 operating regime shift.

scientific_limitations: No confirmed ground-truth anomaly labels exist in BDG2 Panther; flagged hours and contiguous events represent statistical or geometric departures from 2016 training behavior, not verified equipment faults or operational anomalies.

Major 2016-to-2017 valid-zero regime shift: the 29 core Panther education buildings average 383.67 valid zero hours per 1,000 observed hours in 2016 (training) versus 0.00 valid zero hours per 1,000 observed hours in H1 2017 (validation). Because all models, scalers, and quantile thresholds are strictly frozen on 2016 training data without refitting on validation, validation alert rates reflect both hourly departures and this structural operating-regime shift.

In seasonal_deviation mode, statistical_zscore is an intentional 1D univariate slot-deviation baseline (|slot_zscore|), whereas isolation_forest and lof_novelty evaluate the 3D joint vector [slot_zscore, lag_1h_scaled_diff, lag_24h_scaled_diff] over the identical eligible timestamp mask.

Discrete meter quantization and score ties at upper-tail training quantiles can make exact 5.0, 10.0, or 20.0 per 1,000-hour realized training alert rates mathematically impossible under strict exceedance (score > threshold); both nominal_training_flagged_per_1000_hours and training_tied_at_threshold_hours are reported per building.
